{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = 'data/sales.csv'
df = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Check for QA orders with revenue = 999999.99
qa_orders = df[df['revenue'] == '999999.99']
print(f"Number of QA orders (revenue = 999999.99): {len(qa_orders)}")

# Check if they are real orders by looking at status
print("Status of QA orders:")
print(qa_orders['status'].value_counts())

# Check if they are in both channels
print("Channel distribution of QA orders:")
print(qa_orders['channel'].value_counts())"}
